decisions.reason: With the comfort and flagship moulded insoles already pruned, the supportive insole is now the surviving insole that complements the foot-measurement and tailored-fit offer, but the firm's demonstrated readiness to cut insoles keeps its risk elevated.

The ergonomic safety shoe series has its own page and embodies the firm's innovation direction in its core business, so management would keep carrying it while results mature, using slack from the established business.

Firefighter and rescue boots serve a certification-driven niche with long procurement cycles, so a judgement against aspirations needs more than two years and the large firm's slack allows it to persist.
